text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Commissioners Street, City Council approval is required. The TTC service has been rerouted along Villiers Street and Saulter Street South. Waterfront Toronto, City of Toronto, Toronto and Region Conservation Authority (TRCA) and the Toronto Port Lands Company (TPLC) have developed the Port Lands Flood Protection Project (PLFPP) to protect the Lower Don Lands and adjacent areas from potential loss of life and costly flood damage associated with a flood event, while triggering economic development. The solution involves creating two additional outlets for the Don River, which ultimately will be surrounded by new parks, green space and public realm enhancements. City Council authorize the continuation of the temporary full closure of Commissioners Street to all road users from the east curb line of Cherry Street to a point 120 metres east of Don Roadway to October 31, 2023. 2. City Council continue the designation of the north branch of Villiers Street between Cherry Street and Don Roadway as one-way westbound traffic only to October 31, 2023. 3. City Council continue the designation of the south branch of Villiers Street, between Cherry Street and Don Roadway as one-way for eastbound traffic only, to October 31, 2023. 4. City Council authorize the continuation of the installation of temporary traffic control signals at the intersection of Villiers Street and Cherry Street to October 31, 2023. 5.
